_doc: Motion profiles. durations in ms. easing are cubic-bezier. distance is the entrance translate in px. press is the pressed scale. stagger is ms between siblings. spring is [stiffness, damping, mass] for libraries that use springs.

still.describe: Almost no motion. Opacity and color changes only, so nothing competes with the content.

calm-drift.describe: Slow, soft fades and small drifts that ease out. No bounce, no overshoot.

crisp.describe: Short, decisive moves with a firm stop. The interface feels fast and sure.

springy.describe: Light overshoot and squishy presses. Small rewards for every tap.

snappy-tech.describe: Tiny, fast transitions and line-based reveals. Like a good terminal.

theatrical.describe: Slow reveals, staggered lines and long ease-outs. Used for hero moments, not for every control.
